description: A PHP script handling AJAX requests to set IP configuration, including validation for IPv4 and IPv6 settings, and applying network configuration parameters based on POST data.

methods.name: isValidIP
methods.description: Validates if an IPv4 address falls within a specified range.

methods.name: ipRange
methods.description: Calculates the start and end IP addresses of a subnet based on gateway address and subnet mask.

methods.name: valid_GW_IP
methods.description: Checks if the gateway IP address is valid within the provided range.

methods.name: isValidGW
methods.description: Validates the gateway IP address against private IP ranges and subnet masks, and checks if IP addresses are within the valid range.
